title: NSE4 Study Materials
description: FortiGate notes, labs, and certification study material.
summary: The NSE4 is surprisingly in-depth despite the short course offered by Fortinet. The course is free and offered by Fortinet. It is my primary study method alongside labs I create over each section to test on my own FortiGate. I would recommend earning NSE1 - 3 prior to this certification.
